cache_policy: uncached compile and one PublishedCode mapping at a time; no shared cache lookup/admission/key changes
compile_timer_boundary: Each side calls the named baseline or exact S3-32a compiler; block build, decode, verified lowering/transform, allocation, emission, finalization and destruction of the unpublished CompiledBlock are timed. Admission is prepared once before timing. Diagnostic lowering/allocation and summary collection are outside the timer.
native_timer_boundary: Repeated PublishedCode::execute_block calls with the existing safe host wrapper and result collection. State-vector construction and validation are outside the timer; result validation occurs after each timed batch.
publication_timer_boundary: PublishedCode::publish_block and PublishedCode drop are recorded separately for every native side; the prior mapping is dropped before the next publication.
